method: Exact path, pinned commit and content digest comparison of fully read cached source records against corpus artifact inventory; independently enumerated candidate identities and prior exact-path claim overlap. This is provenance reconciliation, not a completed semantic claim audit.

candidate_span_digest_check.method: Independently reconstruct every indexed candidate from the pinned complete source body's splitlines slice at its inclusive physical bounds, join with LF, and compare SHA-256 to text_sha256. All 300 match. This checks provenance, not semantic extraction completeness.
